run.buyerMessage: First choice to inspect: 2019 Subaru Forester Sport AWD. Offer $19,000 before taxes and fees, conditional on verified accident-free/non-salvage history, inspection, completed recalls and a written all-in total no higher than $22,000. Not yet cleared to buy.

listings.offerLabel: Opening offer: not given. The gap versus similar cars is too wide.
listings.reason: Dealer source: https://southcoloradomotors.com/inventory/2019-subaru-forester-sport/1228228. Listing meets AWD, mileage and radius requirements. NHTSA vPIC confirms AWD and Sport trim, but does not verify accident or title history. NHTSA safety evidence gives 5 stars overall/front/side and 4 rollover: https://api.nhtsa.gov/SafetyRatings/VehicleId/13404. NHTSA model-year evidence lists 3 recalls (rear stabilizer bolts, PCV valve, electric steering) and 834 complaints; this is not VIN-specific recall status or a failure rate. Require Subaru recall-completion verification. FuelEconomy.gov closest-configuration match estimates 29 mpg combined, about 1.38 gallons for a 40-mile commute; winter consumption can be higher. Market comps are asking prices, not sold prices: 2019 with 65,935 miles asks $20,998; 2020 with 51,028 miles asks $22,000. $19,000 is an opening negotiation proposal, not a guaranteed accepted price. No clean-history evidence was supplied: require accident-free history report, non-salvage title verification and independent inspection before any purchase. Check CVT, structure, brakes, matching tires, EyeSight operation and child-seat fit. Require an itemized buyer order totaling no more than $22,000 including taxes, registration and dealer fees; actual taxes/fees remain unknown. Allow room within budget for winter tires if necessary. Walk away if history or inspection fails. Suspicious $600–$799 feed entries were not treated as credible purchase prices.
